coordinates_if_missing.precision_note: Government site inventory point; it lies about 0.4 km from DOAM's own Nausharo point, whereas CISI 2 p. XIX puts Sibri 2 km west of Nausharo and the census GeoNames locality (29.3662, 67.5756) fits that description better. Needs a check against Santoni's plan.

notes: Santoni dates Sibri by ceramic links to Mehrgarh VIIC and Central Asia, not by radiocarbon. DOAM gives 2100-1900 BCE in its description but 1900-1300 BCE in its relative-chronology field.
